name: Yayama Haruya
source:
His father runs an import company, and his mother operates an esthetic salon, making their household quite affluent.

As a result, Haruya was often left home alone and craved affection. So his parents decided to hire a tutor for him.

They hired a private instructor and chose music lessons for his emotional development. The instrument Haruya chose was the violin, and the one who came was “Sensei.”
